Zero-copy Arrow ingestion is not claimed (absent in pinned Nautilus); typed Vec<Data> conversion is the boundary.

binary_sha256_reverified.verdict: native and ingest hashes match this file; the parquet runner was rebuilt for the issue-76 chunk-bytes fix

funding_positive_differential_issue_76.why_this_case: 73 of 180 archived pilot variant-days already carry a non-zero funding count; this one was selected from them, so no new data was needed.
funding_positive_differential_issue_76.significance: Previously only a zero-funding day had been compared, so funding tape parity was unproven. This closes that gap with a real settlement applied to an open position.

chunk_bytes_semantics_fix_issue_76.finding: qel-parquet-runner counted one unit per event and compared it against --chunk-bytes, silently reinterpreting a byte budget as an event count.
chunk_bytes_semantics_fix_issue_76.change: The Parquet reader now rejects the flag: exit 1, 'CHUNK_BYTES_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_PARQUET: use --chunk <events>'. Flush boundaries are driven only by the event count.
chunk_bytes_semantics_fix_issue_76.verified: exit 1 with the documented message; replay differential on the funding-positive day still PASS after the change.

independent_reproduction_2026_11_12.timing_caveat: Bounded single-day numbers on a shared 6-vCPU host with the seven-day soak running. They are NOT a controlled A/B and must not be quoted as a speedup claim. The correctness checks (tape, account, counts, hashes) are load-independent.
